desc: The Abbott Afinion™ 2 Analyzer is a compact, semi-automatic point-of-care (POC) analyzer designed for rapid and accurate HbA1c testing. It delivers laboratory-quality results in approximately 3 minutes from a 1.5 µL whole blood sample. With an intuitive touchscreen, automatic quality checks, and LIS connectivity, it is ideal for hospitals, clinics, diabetes centers, and diagnostic laboratories.
